newsitem.title: USA: APOLLO INT'L IN $38 MLN DEAL WITH CHINESE FIRM.
newsitem.headline: APOLLO INT'L IN $38 MLN DEAL WITH CHINESE FIRM.

text.p: Apollo International of Delaware said Wednesday it has signed a five-year, $38 million contract with Beijing East Bridge Machine & Electrical Equipment Co Ltd.
Apollo said that under the contract, it will supply the Chinese company with its intelligent electric-motor protection relays and electric power substation monitoring and protection equipment.
It said shipments willl begin this month, with first year initial sales expected to be at least $3.8 million.
The schedule, if fully implemented, would add $34 million in orders from August 1998 to August 2002.
The U.S. company's products offer cost-effective solutions for electric utilities and users of medium and large industrial electric motors.
